measurement_contract.rss_scope: specific waited command process; descendant aggregation follows the host wait4 semantics

claim_boundary.included: one-command wall time, direct-process peak RSS, exit status, stream digests, host, repository, executable, and allowlisted environment provenance
claim_boundary.excluded: canonical state counts, transition branching, bytes per state, phase timings, eigensolver convergence, checkpoint/restart, width extrapolation, and hardware-rental decisions
